name: GCT return (Form 4A, standard return)
legal_reference: General Consumption Tax Act; Tax Administration Jamaica, GCT forms page — Form 4A is the standard return of the registered taxpayer who supplies goods and services, for a return period of one month, due on or before the last day of the month that follows. Tourism activities (Form 4D), general insurance (Form 4E), special consumption tax (Form 4C), miscellaneous activities (Form 4G) and approved groups (Form 4H) have their own forms, which this pack does not carry. The boxes are the line numbers of Form 4A.

deadline.legal_reference: Tax Administration Jamaica, GCT forms page: Form 4A is due on or before the last day of the month following the return period. Since 1 October 2014 a due date that falls on a weekend or a holiday is not moved to the next working day: the return and the payment are due by the last working day of the month (Jamaica Information Service). The pack's rule gives the last day of the month; the working-day adjustment is not expressible. The Commissioner has extended dates by announcement (after Hurricane Melissa in 2025), which a rule cannot hold.

rounding.legal_reference: Form 4A, instructions: all dollar value amounts are rounded to the nearest whole number.
